Initial release of aibrary-podcast-dialogue.

- Generate engaging podcast scripts featuring a host and guest expert discussing any book conversationally.
- Customize input with book title, author, focus areas, and speaker personalities.
- Structured script includes opening, deep dives into 3–4 topics, rapid fire questions, key takeaways, and closing.
- Dynamic, natural dialogue with real conversation markers and interactive exchanges.
- Adapts output language to match user input; avoids fabricating content for unknown books.
